description: Re-run Mapled's server checks on a setup run after fixing something: the site must read content with the delivery key; a publish webhook that is configured must have delivered and /api/mapled/preview must respond (neither set up yet — a warning, not a failure: both are optional); the created fields should have help texts; each page of the page map, read again from the site, must show 90 % or more from Mapled (the detail quotes what isn't). Returns each check with a detail line. In a setup pass setupId: every applied plan is checked, and the setup is done once every page is in and every check passes.

runId.description: The setup run to check — the old whole-site plan's.

setupId.description: In a setup: the setup, all its plans at once.

name: verify_setup
